details.desc: I develop and lead software projects for real-world engineering applications, working across frontend development, backend systems, GIS, and data. I work directly with clients to understand requirements, make technical decisions, and take projects from development through delivery.

I developed web applications and data-driven tools for transportation and infrastructure projects, focusing on frontend development, GIS, and data visualization. I collaborated with engineers and project teams to turn complex infrastructure data into practical, user-friendly applications.

I designed and implemented the company's website using HubSpot and developed a chatbot using AWS. I also built several supporting functions for the company's online services, gaining hands-on experience across web development, cloud services, and backend functionality.

I developed and maintained websites for two professors using Drupal. I translated design and content requirements into functional web experiences, working directly with faculty to structure content, implement site features, and maintain the sites over time.
